# GTA6mapx — GTA 6 Interactive Map (State of Leonida)

GTA6mapx is a fan-made interactive map and guide hub for Grand Theft Auto VI, covering the fictional state of Leonida — including Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The site tracks only what Rockstar Games has confirmed or shown in official trailers, labels every claim by evidence level (Rockstar-confirmed, trailer-confirmed, leak-reported, disputed), and publishes 3,599 guides and articles in its blog.

## Map

- [Interactive GTA 6 map of Leonida](https://gta6mapx.com/): the homepage map — explore Vice City and the regions of Leonida with 2,850+ points of interest and deep-zoom tiles.

## Blog and guides

- [Blog — all GTA 6 guides](https://gta6mapx.com/blog): the full guide index, searchable and sortable.
- [GTA 6 Guides](https://gta6mapx.com/blog/category/guides): complete guides and explainers — release date, map, platforms, price, characters and cheats.
- [News & Updates](https://gta6mapx.com/blog/category/gta-6-updates): announcements, updates and explainers from across the GTA 6 beat.
- [Questions & Answers](https://gta6mapx.com/blog/category/qa): straight, evidence-labelled answers to the biggest GTA 6 questions.
- [Vice Wire Deep Dives](https://gta6mapx.com/blog/category/deep-dives): long-form investigations — cartography, district lore, trailer analysis and engine breakdowns.

## For crawlers and agents

- [Sitemap](https://gta6mapx.com/sitemap.xml): every published guide URL.
- [AI catalog (JSON)](https://gta6mapx.com/ai-catalog.json): a machine-readable manifest of this site's public resources and API endpoints.
- Public API: `GET https://gta6mapx.com/api/blogs` (paginated guide list, supports search/sort/category) and `GET https://gta6mapx.com/api/blogs/popular` (the 10 homepage guides).
